title: Playboy Magazine May 1990 Margaux Hemingway Dave Barry John Malkovich
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible cover wear, creases and edge/corner wear. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, May 1990 issue. Cover price $4.00.

Features:
- Margaux Hemingway: "Papa Said, Flaunt It!" - cover and pictorial
- Interview: Dave Barry
- Profile: John Malkovich
- 20 Questions: Jennifer Tilly
- Baseball 1990: It's Money, Money, Money
- Music Winners: results of our biggest poll ever
- Great news about sex in the nineties
